title: Rings&More
description: Resource pack that adds name dependent textures to some resources,  making them look like rings. There are plans to add more textures in the future.
body:
Texture pack which adds name dependent textures to some resources. Oryginally made for private server with my girlfriend, who made me post this, so thank her i guess. In the future i might add more textures like necklaces, bacelets or some other jewlery.

Currently available textures:\
Diamond:
- Diamond Golden Ring
- Diamond Silver Ring

Emerald:
- Emerald Golden Ring
- Emerald Silver Ring

Amethyst Shard:
- Amethyst Golden Ring
- Amethyst Silver Ring

Nether Quartz:
- Quartz Golden Ring
- Quartz Silver Ring

Lapis lazuli:
- Sapphire Golden Ring
- Sapphire Silver Ring

Redstone:
- Ruby Golden Ring
- Ruby Silver Ring

Coal:
- Onyx Golden Ring
- Onyx Silver Ring

Resin Brick:
- Amber Golden Ring
- Amber Silver Ring

Any suggestions or reported issues will be appreciated. Post them in the YouTube comment section (will insert link here after making the video).
